assumptions: UI and API share one origin
decisions: Use an original midnight-indigo, parchment, coral, and lime visual system named Signal Desk
Create semantic public and operator workspaces in one page
Render API strings with textContent and validate all href protocols
Apply restrictive CSP only to the application shell
Rollback by reverting the single UI commit and re-running API/UI checks
evidence: Design specifies exact files/routes, state transitions, CSP, DOM-safety rules, breakpoints, tests, and rollback verification
Existing API already supplies every required operation without contract changes
risks: Local admin-key entry is not production identity
summary: Designed the additive Signal Desk interface with same-origin data flow, accessible responsive behavior, memory-only operator credentials, and code-only rollback.
